mapper.select: SELECT fg.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, fg.child_id AS childId, fg.financial_goal_template_id AS financialGoalTemplateId, fg.title, fg.target_amount AS targetAmount, fg.target_date AS targetDate, fg.status FROM financial_goal fg INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = fg.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = fg.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE fg.financial_goal_id = #{financialGoalId} AND fg.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT financial_account_id FROM financial_goal_account WHERE financial_goal_id = #{financialGoalId} ORDER BY linked_at ASC, financial_goal_account_id ASC

SELECT fg.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, fg.child_id AS childId, fg.financial_goal_template_id AS financialGoalTemplateId, fg.title, fgt.icon_key AS iconKey, fg.target_amount AS targetAmount, fg.target_date AS targetDate, fg.monthly_saving_amount AS monthlySavingAmount, fg.status, fa.financial_account_id AS accountId, fa.account_name AS accountName, fa.bank_name AS bankName, fa.account_number_ciphertext AS accountNumberCiphertext, fa.balance FROM financial_goal fg LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fg.financial_goal_template_id INNER JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_goal_id = fg.financial_goal_id INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = fga.financial_account_id INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = fg.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = fg.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE fg.financial_goal_id = #{financialGoalId} AND fg.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED') ORDER BY fga.linked_at ASC, fga.financial_goal_account_id ASC

SELECT financial_goal_checkpoint_id AS financialGoalCheckpointId, percentage, target_amount AS targetAmount, reached_at AS reachedAt FROM financial_goal_checkpoint WHERE financial_goal_id = #{financialGoalId} ORDER BY percentage ASC

SELECT fg.financial_goal_id AS financialGoalId, fg.child_id AS childId, fg.financial_goal_template_id AS financialGoalTemplateId, fg.title, fgt.icon_key AS iconKey, fg.target_amount AS targetAmount, fg.target_date AS targetDate, fg.status, fg.created_at AS createdAt, fa.financial_account_id AS accountId, fa.account_name AS accountName, fa.bank_name AS bankName, fa.account_number_ciphertext AS accountNumberCiphertext, fa.balance FROM financial_goal fg LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fg.financial_goal_template_id INNER JOIN financial_goal_account fga ON fga.financial_goal_id = fg.financial_goal_id INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = fga.financial_account_id WHERE fg.child_id = #{childId} AND fg.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED') ORDER BY fg.created_at DESC, fg.financial_goal_id DESC, fga.linked_at ASC, fga.financial_goal_account_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_goal ( child_id, financial_goal_template_id, title, target_amount, target_date, monthly_saving_amount, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{financialGoalTemplateId}, #{title}, #{targetAmount}, #{targetDate}, #{monthlySavingAmount}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
INSERT INTO financial_goal_account ( financial_goal_id, financial_account_id, linked_at ) VALUES ( #{financialGoalId}, #{financialAccountId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )

INSERT INTO financial_goal_checkpoint ( financial_goal_id, percentage, target_amount, reached_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{financialGoalId}, #{percentage}, #{targetAmount}, #{reachedAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_goal SET target_amount = #{targetAmount}, target_date = #{targetDate}, monthly_saving_amount = #{monthlySavingAmount}, status = #{status}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE financial_goal_id = #{financialGoalId}
UPDATE financial_goal SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE financial_goal_id = #{financialGoalId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED')
